summary: First-finish smoke test after initial implementation of Agenda Colaborativa. Backend (20 checks) and frontend (8 checks) all passed. Critical owner-authorization rule verified: user Gustavo receives 403 with pt-br message when trying to edit/delete Maria's appointment; admin can edit/delete any. Seed data loaded correctly. Frontend calendar renders, modals open in view/edit mode based on ownership, admin route guards correctly.
passed: POST /api/auth/login admin returns token and user (role=admin); GET /api/auth/me validates token
POST /api/auth/login invalid -> 401 with detail 'E-mail ou senha inválidos'
GET /api/users as admin returns full list with emails; as user returns list with emails masked to null for others (only own email visible)
POST /api/users (admin) creates user; PUT /api/users/{id} deactivates user (active=false); DELETE /api/users/{id} works
POST/PUT/DELETE /api/teams work for admin
GET /api/appointments?start&end returns seed appointments for user's team (6 seed items)
POST /api/appointments as Gustavo -> user_id auto-assigned to gustavo id
PUT /api/appointments/{id} own -> 200; PUT other user's -> 403 'Você só pode editar seus próprios compromissos'
DELETE /api/appointments/{id} other user's -> 403 'Você só pode excluir seus próprios compromissos'
Admin PUT/DELETE any appointment -> 200
GET /api/appointments/conflicts detects overlap correctly (returns list, does not block creation)
POST /api/appointments end<=start -> 400 'O horário final deve ser após o inicial'
Frontend /login: email+password submit redirects to /
Frontend Agenda grid renders 72 slots and 7 event tiles for Gustavo's team
Week nav buttons (prev/today/next) work
Click on other user's event opens view-only modal (no save/delete buttons)
Click on own event opens modal with save button (edit mode)
Click free slot (slot-2026-08-18-10) opens new-appointment modal with title field
/admin as user Gustavo -> redirected to /
/admin as admin loads, tabs Usuários/Equipes switch, btn-new-user present
